blocks.text: At Machhiwara the Guru remains in concealment while a few Singhs drift in and out, and even ordinary acts like preparing food turn into signs of danger for those sheltering him. (4–6)

The host is bribed into silence for a time, and when departure becomes necessary the Pathan allies and Sayyads help arrange a blue robe disguise so the Guru can travel outward under the appearance of a fasting holy man. (7–10)
This blue robe disguise marks the shift from hidden survival to controlled movement, with outward costume becoming part of the strategy of escape. (overall)
